issues.description: audio_format is derived from sample_rate via f-string with no validation against STTAudioFormat literal
issues.detail: sample_rate is an unconstrained int yet is cast to STTAudioFormat via f"pcm_{sample_rate}". A caller passing 11025 or 32000 silently produces an invalid string that the server rejects. The type cast lies. Validate sample_rate against the allowed Literal set at construction and raise immediately, or accept audio_format directly.

issues.description: Fatal error messages raised from _process_stream_event are swallowed by recv_task's bare except
issues.detail: On auth_error or quota_exceeded, the handler raises APIConnectionError from inside recv_task, which wraps the call in a bare except Exception that logs and continues the while-True loop. The error is both raised and swallowed, so a dead session spins forever. Re-raise APIConnectionError specifically or set a termination flag and break.

issues.description: Reconnect loop is dead scaffolding: _reconnect_event is never set and exceptions are swallowed
issues.detail: The outer while True only loops when _reconnect_event is set, but nothing in the file sets it. tasks_group.exception() is called purely for its side effect of marking the exception retrieved, discarding real send/recv errors. There is no termination function, no backoff, and the wait_reconnect branch is unreachable. Either wire reconnect on task failure or delete the scaffolding.

issues.description: Speaking-state flag complects segment identity with transcript value via implicit state machine
issues.detail: self._speaking is mutated from _process_stream_event across two message-type branches with no documented invariant: it survives reconnects unchanged, an empty committed_transcript before any partial silently does nothing, and END_OF_SPEECH may never fire. Make the segment an explicit value (segment_id + state) with a pure transition function over events.

issues.description: Documented parameter ranges are not enforced at construction
issues.detail: Docstring states vad_silence_threshold_secs must be 0.3-3.0, vad_threshold 0.1-0.9, durations 50-2000, but none of these are checked. The user discovers violations via an opaque WebSocket disconnect from the server. Validate at __init__ and raise ValueError with the bounds — cheap, obvious, and saves a support ticket.

issues.description: No tests added for a stateful streaming protocol, justified by precedent
issues.detail: Author concedes tests were skipped because the suite is broken since May 2025. A WebSocket protocol with partial/committed/empty-commit transitions and a speaking flag is exactly what regresses silently. At minimum, feed canned messages through _process_stream_event and assert the event sequence. An hour of work catches real bugs and pins down the state machine.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. Three concrete bugs block landing: sample_rate is cast to an STTAudioFormat literal via f-string with no validation, fatal error messages are raised into a recv_task that swallows them, and the reconnect loop is dead scaffolding because _reconnect_event is never set. Beyond bugs, the speech-segment state machine is complected with transcript values via a mutable boolean flag with no stated invariant, documented parameter ranges go unchecked, and the author concedes no tests were added. Fix the validation, wire or remove the reconnect machinery, make error termination explicit, and add at least one focused unit test over _process_stream_event before merge.
